purpose: Keep approved portfolio media, Cloudinary delivery, performance, SEO, and release governance in step.
sourceOfTruth: Checked-in approved derivatives and their knowledge-wiki/photo release records remain canonical; Cloudinary is a rendition CDN only.

excluded: Open Graph render inputs and output

hardGates: Each CDN asset is bound to an exact local SHA-256 and immutable Cloudinary version.
No asset enters the manifest without public Git, staging, and Cloudinary-public-delivery approval.
Production and indexing remain open human gates.
Cloudinary credentials, unsigned presets, upload widgets, and auto-upload URLs never enter public code.
Responsive widths are bounded; transforms use c_limit and measured WebP quality policies of 30 for photographs and 35 for screenshots.
An explicit local-delivery override provides rollback.
The shared CDN hostname is preconnected only when the canary is enabled.
The current local social preview and resume PDF delivery remain unchanged.
Staging emits noindex headers and is verified against one exact commit.

hillClimb.objective: Eliminate the app-server image proxy hop and lengthen immutable browser caching without a material first-view byte regression or any weakening of visual fidelity, rights, accessibility, or release discipline.
procedure: Run deterministic manifest and loader tests.
Build the staging candidate and inspect rendered image URLs.
Compare representative local and Cloudinary response bytes at matched widths.
Inspect desktop and mobile rendering for crop, alt text, layout, and legibility.
Keep the change only if all hard gates pass and rollback remains available.
